title: The oath in the peach garden
summary: Liu Bei, a straw-sandal seller of imperial descent, the butcher Zhang Fei and the fugitive Guan Yu swear brotherhood among the peach blossoms in Zhang Fei's garden: not born on the same day, they will die on the same day. Historically: the Records of the Three Kingdoms says only that the three slept in the same bed and were close as brothers. There was no oath.
summary_zh: 卖草鞋的汉室宗亲刘备、屠户张飞、亡命的关羽，在张飞庄后桃园焚香结拜：不求同年同月同日生，但愿同年同月同日死。史实：《三国志·关羽传》只说三人“寝则同床，恩若兄弟”，并无桃园结义之事。

title: The Yellow Turbans rise
place_zh: 巨鹿郡（今河北平乡一带）
summary: Zhang Jiao of Julu, preacher of the Way of Great Peace, raises hundreds of thousands across eight provinces under yellow headcloths: 'The blue heaven is dead, the yellow heaven shall rise.' The novel opens here, as the history does.
summary_zh: 巨鹿人张角以太平道传教十余年，信众数十万遍布八州，头裹黄巾一齐起事，口号是“苍天已死，黄天当立，岁在甲子，天下大吉”。小说和史书都从这里写起。

title: Fire at Changshe
place_zh: 颍川长社（今河南长葛东）
summary: The Han generals Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun, besieged at Changshe, set the rebels' grass camp alight in a night wind and rout them; the young cavalry commander Cao Cao arrives to join the pursuit. This is the reader's first sight of Cao Cao, and it is history.
summary_zh: 皇甫嵩、朱儁被黄巾围于长社，乘夜风纵火烧其草营，大破黄巾。年轻的骑都尉曹操率军赶到，参与追击。这是读者第一次见到曹操，史有其事。

title: The brothers' first battle
summary: With five hundred volunteers the three brothers meet a Yellow Turban army; Zhang Fei spears Deng Mao and Guan Yu cuts down Cheng Yuanzhi. Historically: Liu Bei did raise a band and fight the Yellow Turbans under the colonel Zou Jing, and was rewarded with a minor post; the duels and the names are the novel's.
summary_zh: 三兄弟招募乡勇五百，迎战黄巾，张飞刺死邓茂，关羽斩程远志。史实：《三国志·先主传》载刘备率部众随校尉邹靖讨黄巾有功，授安喜县尉；阵斩二将及其姓名出自小说。

title: Zhang Fei whips the inspector
place_zh: 中山安喜县（今河北定州东）
summary: A corrupt inspector humiliates Liu Bei, now sheriff of Anxi, and demands a bribe. Zhang Fei drags him out, ties him to a hitching post and breaks ten willow switches on him, and the brothers leave office. Historically: it was Liu Bei himself who tied up the inspector and gave him two hundred strokes. The novel hands the anger to Zhang Fei to keep its hero mild.
summary_zh: 督邮索贿刁难安喜县尉刘备，张飞揪他出来绑在拴马桩上，折柳条连打十几根，兄弟三人弃官而去。史实：《三国志·先主传》及裴注《典略》载，绑督邮、杖二百的是刘备本人。小说把这口怒气转给了张飞，好保住主角宽厚的形象。

title: He Jin plots against the eunuchs and is killed
summary: After Emperor Ling dies, the regent He Jin plans to destroy the palace eunuchs and summons provincial armies, Dong Zhuo's among them, against Cao Cao's advice. The eunuchs lure him into the palace and behead him; Yuan Shao storms in and kills two thousand eunuchs.
summary_zh: 灵帝驾崩，大将军何进谋诛宦官，不听曹操劝阻，召董卓等外兵进京。十常侍诱何进入宫杀之，袁绍率兵入宫，尽杀宦官二千余人。

title: Lü Bu kills his master for a horse
summary: Dong Zhuo sends Li Su to Lü Bu with gold, pearls and the horse Red Hare. Lü Bu cuts off his adoptive father Ding Yuan's head and goes over to Dong Zhuo. Historically: Lü Bu did kill Ding Yuan and join Dong Zhuo, and Red Hare was his horse ('Lü Bu among men, Red Hare among horses'), but the gift of the horse is the novel's.
summary_zh: 董卓派李肃携黄金、明珠和赤兔马去说降吕布。吕布斩义父丁原首级，投了董卓。史实：吕布杀丁原、归董卓确有其事，赤兔也确是吕布坐骑（“人中有吕布，马中有赤兔”），但董卓以赤兔相赠出自小说。

title: Dong Zhuo deposes the emperor
summary: Master of the capital, Dong Zhuo deposes the young emperor, later poisons him, and puts his nine-year-old half-brother on the throne as Emperor Xian, the last of the Han.
summary_zh: 董卓控制京师，废少帝为弘农王，后又鸩杀之，立年仅九岁的陈留王刘协为帝，即汉献帝，东汉最后一位皇帝。

title: Cao Cao's dagger, and Lü Boshe
summary: Cao Cao tries to stab Dong Zhuo, turns the dagger into a gift and flees. The magistrate of Zhongmou, Chen Gong, arrests him and then runs away with him; at the house of his father's friend Lü Boshe Cao Cao kills the family in a panic and says: better I wrong the world than the world wrong me. Historically: the attempted stabbing is invented; Cao Cao was held at Zhongmou by an unnamed official and released, not by Chen Gong; the killing of Lü Boshe's household survives in three conflicting versions, and only one gives him the famous line, in milder words.
summary_zh: 曹操借献七星刀行刺董卓不成，逃出洛阳，在中牟被县令陈宫拿住，陈宫弃官随他出逃。在故人吕伯奢家，曹操疑心起杀尽其家，说出“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我”。史实：献刀行刺是小说虚构；《三国志·武帝纪》载曹操在中牟被一位不知名的亭长疑为逃犯扣下，又被放走，并非陈宫；杀吕伯奢家一事在裴注所引三种史料中说法互相矛盾，只有孙盛《杂记》记有他说“宁我负人，毋人负我”。

title: Eighteen lords against Dong Zhuo
summary: Cao Cao forges an imperial summons and the eastern lords rise; eighteen of them meet with Yuan Shao as their leader. Historically: the eastern coalition of 190 was real and did choose Yuan Shao as its head, but it never assembled in one place and was not eighteen strong; its armies camped separately at Suanzao, Henei and Luyang and mostly avoided battle.
summary_zh: 曹操发矫诏，关东诸侯响应，十八路人马会盟，推袁绍为盟主。史实：190年关东联军确有其事，也确推袁绍为盟主，但从未在一处会师，也不是十八路；各军分驻酸枣、河内、鲁阳等地，大多按兵不动。

title: Guan Yu kills Hua Xiong before the wine cools
place_zh: 汜水关（今河南荥阳汜水镇）
summary: Dong Zhuo's general Hua Xiong cuts down champion after champion. Guan Yu, a mere mounted archer, asks to go; Cao Cao pours him a cup of hot wine, and he returns with Hua Xiong's head before it has cooled. Historically: Hua Xiong was killed by Sun Jian's army at Yangren, as the Records of the Three Kingdoms says in Sun Jian's biography. Guan Yu had nothing to do with it.
summary_zh: 董卓部将华雄连斩联军数将。马弓手关羽请战，曹操斟热酒一杯，关羽提华雄首级回来时酒尚温。史实：《三国志·孙坚传》载华雄是孙坚在阳人之战中所斩，与关羽无关。

title: Three heroes fight Lü Bu
place_zh: 虎牢关（今河南荥阳汜水镇西）
summary: Lü Bu rides out of Hulao Pass and no lord can stand against him. Zhang Fei, then Guan Yu, then Liu Bei take him on together until he retreats. Historically: there was no such fight; Liu Bei was not part of the coalition's front at all. Hulao and Sishui are in fact two names for the same pass.
summary_zh: 吕布出虎牢关，诸侯无人能敌。张飞、关羽、刘备先后上阵，三人合战吕布，吕布败走。史实：并无此战，刘备当时根本不在联军前线。虎牢关与汜水关其实是同一处关隘的两个名字。

title: Dong Zhuo burns Luoyang
summary: Dong Zhuo moves the court and a million people west to Chang'an, burns the palaces and the city, and has the imperial tombs dug up for their treasure. For years Luoyang lies empty.
summary_zh: 董卓挟天子西迁长安，驱赶洛阳百万百姓同行，焚烧宫室民居，又命吕布发掘帝陵取宝。洛阳从此荒废多年。

title: Sun Jian hides the imperial seal
summary: Entering the ruins, Sun Jian's men find the jade seal of the empire in a well and he keeps it secretly, breaking his oath to the coalition. Historically: the story comes from the Book of Wu cited in the notes to the Records; the commentator Pei Songzhi himself doubted that the loyal Sun Jian would hide it.
summary_zh: 孙坚进入洛阳废墟，在井中得到传国玉玺，背着盟约藏匿起来。史实：此事出自裴松之注所引《吴书》，裴松之本人就怀疑忠于汉室的孙坚会私藏玉玺。

title: Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan at the Pan River
summary: Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan go to war over Ji province. Gongsun Zan is about to be speared when a young officer from Changshan, Zhao Yun, rides in and saves him: Zhao Yun's first appearance. Historically: the battle, at Jieqiao, was real and Yuan Shao won it with crossbowmen; Zhao Yun's rescue is the novel's.
summary_zh: 袁绍与公孙瓒争夺冀州。公孙瓒险被文丑刺中，常山少年赵云挺枪救下，这是赵云首次登场。史实：两军确在界桥交战，袁绍以麹义的强弩兵大破公孙瓒白马义从；赵云救公孙瓒出自小说。

title: Sun Jian dies at Xian Hill
place_zh: 襄阳岘山（今湖北襄阳南）
summary: Sent by Yuan Shu against Liu Biao, Sun Jian crosses the Han River and besieges Xiangyang. Riding alone through the hills at night he is shot down by Huang Zu's men. He is thirty-seven; his sons Sun Ce and Sun Quan will build Wu.
summary_zh: 孙坚受袁术之命进攻刘表，渡汉水围襄阳。他单骑行经岘山，被黄祖部下伏兵射杀，年仅三十七岁。其子孙策、孙权后来开创东吴基业。

title: Diaochan and the chain of stratagems
summary: The minister Wang Yun promises his singing girl Diaochan to Lü Bu and then gives her to Dong Zhuo. Lü Bu finds her weeping in the Phoenix Pavilion and Dong Zhuo throws a halberd at him. Historically: Diaochan never existed. The Records of the Three Kingdoms says Lü Bu was having an affair with one of Dong Zhuo's maids, feared discovery, and that Wang Yun used his unease to recruit him.
summary_zh: 司徒王允先将歌女貂蝉许给吕布，又献给董卓，挑拨父子反目。吕布在凤仪亭见貂蝉哭诉，董卓掷戟刺他。史实：貂蝉其人不见于史书。《三国志·吕布传》载吕布与董卓的侍婢私通，恐事发心中不安，王允便利用这一点说动他做内应。

title: Lü Bu kills Dong Zhuo
summary: As Dong Zhuo enters the palace, Lü Bu runs him through on the emperor's order. His corpse is left in the street; the guards put a lamp wick in his navel, and it burns for days on his fat.
summary_zh: 董卓入宫朝贺，吕布奉诏书将他刺死。董卓暴尸街头，守尸吏在他肚脐里点上灯芯，脂膏流地，燃了好几天。

title: Li Jue and Guo Si take Chang'an
summary: Refused a pardon, Dong Zhuo's generals Li Jue and Guo Si take Jia Xu's advice and march on Chang'an. Lü Bu flees, Wang Yun is killed, and the emperor falls into the hands of a new pair of warlords.
summary_zh: 董卓部将李傕、郭汜求赦不得，听从贾诩之计反攻长安。吕布出逃，王允被杀，献帝又落入新的军阀手中。

title: Cao Cao avenges his father in Xuzhou
summary: Cao Cao's father Cao Song is murdered with his family on the road through Tao Qian's territory. Cao Cao invades Xuzhou and puts the countryside to the sword. Historically: the sources disagree on who killed Cao Song, but agree on the revenge: the Book of the Later Han says hundreds of thousands were killed and the Si River was choked with bodies.
summary_zh: 曹操之父曹嵩携家眷途经陶谦辖境被害，曹操起兵攻徐州，所到之处大肆屠戮。史实：谁杀了曹嵩，诸书说法不一，但对复仇的记载一致：《后汉书·陶谦传》说男女被杀数十万人，泗水为之不流。

title: Ma Teng and Han Sui march on Chang'an
summary: The Liang province warlords Ma Teng and Han Sui march on Chang'an to rid the court of Li Jue and Guo Si, and are beaten back at Changping. Ma Teng's son Ma Chao, seventeen, shows his mettle for the first time.
summary_zh: 西凉马腾、韩遂起兵讨伐李傕、郭汜，在长平观战败退回。马腾之子马超年方十七，初露锋芒。

title: Lü Bu defeats Cao Cao at Puyang
place_zh: 东郡濮阳（今河南濮阳西南）
summary: While Cao Cao is away in Xuzhou, Chen Gong and Zhang Miao hand Yan province to Lü Bu. At Puyang Cao Cao is lured into the city, the gates are fired, and he escapes with his beard and hand burned; Dian Wei holds the line.
summary_zh: 曹操远征徐州，陈宫、张邈迎吕布入兖州。曹操攻濮阳中计入城，城门火起，他烧伤手掌、焦了胡须才逃出，典韦死战断后。

title: Liu Bei relieves Kong Rong at Beihai
place_zh: 北海国剧县（今山东寿光东南）
summary: Besieged by Yellow Turban remnants, Kong Rong sends Taishi Ci through the lines to Liu Bei, who comes with three thousand men and lifts the siege. Kong Rong's surprise that Liu Bei even knew his name is in the Records too.
summary_zh: 孔融被黄巾余部管亥围困，派太史慈突围求救于刘备，刘备率三千兵解围。刘备惊讶孔融竟知世间有刘备，《三国志·太史慈传》也有记载。

title: Tao Qian offers Xuzhou three times
summary: Tao Qian offers his province to Liu Bei three times, and Liu Bei refuses twice before accepting on the old man's deathbed. Historically: Tao Qian, dying, told his officer Mi Zhu that only Liu Bei could hold the province, and Mi Zhu brought the province to him. One offer, not three; the novel triples it to show Liu Bei's modesty.
summary_zh: 陶谦三次要把徐州让给刘备，刘备两次推辞，直到陶谦临终才接受。史实：《三国志·先主传》载陶谦病重时对别驾麋竺说“非刘备不能安此州”，麋竺率州人迎刘备。只有一次，小说添成三让，以显刘备谦让。

title: The emperor escapes from Chang'an
place_zh: 弘农曹阳（今河南灵宝东）
summary: Li Jue and Guo Si turn on each other, one holding the emperor and the other the ministers. In the confusion the court flees east, chased and robbed all the way, crossing the Yellow River at night in a single boat, and reaches the ruins of Luoyang living on wild plants.
summary_zh: 李傕、郭汜反目相攻，一个劫持天子，一个扣押公卿。献帝趁乱东逃，一路被追兵抢掠，夜里乘一条小船渡过黄河，回到满目废墟的洛阳，百官采野菜充饥。

title: Taishi Ci and the Little Conqueror at Shenting
summary: Sun Ce, scouting with thirteen riders, meets Taishi Ci alone. They fight until Sun Ce has Taishi Ci's short halberd and Taishi Ci has Sun Ce's helmet. Later captured, Taishi Ci joins him. All of it is in the Records.
summary_zh: 孙策带十三骑侦察，与单骑巡哨的太史慈相遇，两人厮打，孙策夺得太史慈背后的手戟，太史慈抢得孙策的头盔。后来太史慈被俘归降。这些《三国志·太史慈传》都有记载。

title: Cao Cao brings the emperor to Xu
summary: Cao Cao takes the starving court from Luoyang to his base at Xu. From now on he holds the emperor and commands the lords in his name, the advantage that wins him the north.
summary_zh: 曹操将饥困的朝廷从洛阳迎到自己的根据地许县，从此“奉天子以令不臣”，这是他统一北方的最大本钱。

title: Lü Bu seizes Xuzhou
summary: Left to guard Xiapi, Zhang Fei gets drunk and whips Cao Bao, Lü Bu's father-in-law, who opens the gates to Lü Bu by night. Historically: Zhang Fei did quarrel with Cao Bao and killed him, and the city did fall to Lü Bu from inside, through a Danyang officer who opened the gate; the drunken whipping and the father-in-law are the novel's.
summary_zh: 张飞留守下邳，醉后鞭打吕布的岳父曹豹，曹豹夜开城门迎吕布。史实：据裴注引《英雄记》，张飞与曹豹失和，杀了曹豹，城中丹杨兵将领许耽开门迎入吕布；醉酒鞭打和“岳父”之说出自小说。

title: Sun Ce takes the lower Yangzi
summary: With his father's old troops, borrowed from Yuan Shu for the jade seal, Sun Ce crosses the Yangzi and takes Danyang, Wu and Kuaiji in two years, defeating Liu Yao, Yan Baihu and Wang Lang. The Little Conqueror is twenty-one.
summary_zh: 孙策以传国玉玺为质，向袁术借回父亲旧部，渡江东进，两年间击败刘繇、严白虎、王朗，据有丹阳、吴郡、会稽。“小霸王”时年二十一岁。

title: Lü Bu shoots the halberd at the camp gate
summary: Yuan Shu's general Ji Ling attacks Liu Bei at Xiaopei. Lü Bu invites both to a feast, plants a halberd at the camp gate a hundred and fifty paces away, and says: if my arrow hits the side blade, you both go home. It hits. This is the Records, almost word for word.
summary_zh: 袁术部将纪灵攻打小沛的刘备。吕布请双方赴宴，在营门立一支戟，说一箭射中戟的小枝，两家就罢兵。一箭正中。《三国志·吕布传》几乎原样记载。

title: Defeat at Wan: Dian Wei dies
summary: Zhang Xiu surrenders, then rebels when Cao Cao takes his uncle's widow into his tent. In the night attack Cao Cao's eldest son Cao Ang and his nephew die, and Dian Wei holds the gate alone until he falls.
summary_zh: 张绣投降后，曹操纳其婶母邹氏，张绣羞怒，夜袭曹营。曹操长子曹昂、侄子曹安民战死，典韦独守营门，力战而死。

title: Yuan Shu calls himself emperor
summary: Holding the jade seal and trusting a prophecy, Yuan Shu proclaims himself emperor of a new dynasty at Shouchun. Every other lord turns on him, and his lavish court starves its people.
summary_zh: 袁术自恃得了传国玉玺，又迷信谶语，在寿春称帝，国号“仲”。各路诸侯群起而攻，他宫中奢靡无度，百姓饥馑相食。

title: Cao Cao cuts his hair for his head
summary: Cao Cao orders death for anyone who tramples the wheat. When his own horse bolts into a field, he cuts off his hair instead of his head. The story is in the Cao Man zhuan cited in the notes to the Records.
summary_zh: 曹操下令践踏麦田者斩，自己的马受惊踏入麦田，便割下头发代替首级。此事见于裴注所引《曹瞒传》。

title: Xiahou Dun swallows his own eye
summary: An arrow strikes Xiahou Dun in the left eye. He pulls it out with the eyeball on it, cries that his parents' flesh and blood must not be wasted, swallows the eye and kills the archer. Historically: the Records says only that a stray arrow cost him his left eye in the war against Lü Bu, and that he hated mirrors ever after.
summary_zh: 夏侯惇左目中箭，拔箭连眼珠带出，大呼“父精母血，不可弃也”，将眼珠吞下，挺枪刺死放箭之人。史实：《三国志·夏侯惇传》只说他征吕布时被流矢射伤左眼，裴注引《魏略》说他从此厌恶照镜子。

title: Lü Bu dies at the White Gate Tower
summary: Cao Cao floods Xiapi and Lü Bu's officers hand him over bound. He begs to serve Cao Cao; Liu Bei remarks, 'Remember Ding Yuan and Dong Zhuo', and Cao Cao has him strangled. Chen Gong goes to his death refusing to beg. All of this is in the Records.
summary_zh: 曹操水淹下邳，吕布部将缚吕布出降。吕布求曹操收用，刘备在旁说：“明公不见吕布事丁建阳、董太师乎？”曹操遂下令缢杀吕布。陈宫不肯求饶，从容就死。这些都见于《三国志》。

title: The edict sewn in a belt
summary: The emperor's father-in-law Dong Cheng says he has a secret edict, sewn into a jade belt, ordering Cao Cao's death, and gathers conspirators, Liu Bei among them. The plot is discovered in 200 and all but Liu Bei are killed.
summary_zh: 国舅董承自称受了缝在玉带中的密诏，要诛杀曹操，联络刘备等人。次年事泄，董承等人被杀，只有刘备因出征在外得免。《三国志·先主传》记有“受帝衣带中密诏”。

title: The hunt at Xutian
summary: At an imperial hunt Cao Cao shoots a deer with the emperor's own bow and accepts the cheers meant for the throne. Guan Yu wants to kill him on the spot; Liu Bei stops him. Historically: the Records of Shu cited in the notes says that during a hunt at Xu Guan Yu urged Liu Bei to kill Cao Cao and Liu Bei refused; the deer and the emperor's arrow are the novel's.
summary_zh: 许田围猎，曹操借天子宝弓金箭射中一鹿，群臣以为天子射中，齐呼万岁，曹操竟纵马挡在天子前受贺。关羽提刀欲斩曹操，被刘备拦住。史实：裴注引《蜀记》载刘备在许都时与曹操共猎，关羽劝刘备杀曹，刘备不从；射鹿、受贺出自小说。

title: Talking of heroes over warm wine
summary: Over green plums and warm wine Cao Cao asks who the heroes of the age are, dismisses every name Liu Bei offers, and says: there are only two, you and I. Liu Bei drops his chopsticks and blames a clap of thunder. Historically: the line and the dropped chopsticks are in the Records; the thunder comes from the Chronicle of Huayang, and the plums and wine from the novel.
summary_zh: 青梅煮酒，曹操问天下英雄，刘备列举袁术、袁绍、刘表、孙策，都被曹操一一否定。曹操说：“今天下英雄，惟使君与操耳。”刘备吓得筷子落地，借雷声掩饰。史实：这句话和失落匕箸见于《三国志·先主传》，借雷声掩饰出自《华阳国志》，青梅煮酒是小说的点缀。

title: Guan Yu takes Xuzhou by a ruse
summary: Sent out against Yuan Shu, Liu Bei turns back on Cao Cao's governor of Xuzhou, Che Zhou; Guan Yu tricks him into opening the gate and cuts him down. Historically: the Records says simply that Liu Bei killed Che Zhou and held Xuzhou. The novel gives the deed to Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 刘备奉命截击袁术，趁机反曹，关羽诈称曹军，赚开城门斩了徐州刺史车胄。史实：《三国志·先主传》只说“先主遂杀徐州刺史车胄”，小说把功劳记在关羽名下。

title: Guan Yu and Zhang Fei capture Wang Zhong and Liu Dai
summary: Cao Cao sends Wang Zhong and Liu Dai against the rebel Liu Bei; Guan Yu takes one alive and Zhang Fei the other, and Liu Bei sends them back to soften Cao Cao. Historically: the Records says Cao Cao sent the two and they failed; the captures are the novel's.
summary_zh: 曹操派王忠、刘岱攻打反叛的刘备，关羽生擒王忠，张飞活捉刘岱，刘备又把二人放回以缓和关系。史实：《三国志·先主传》注只说曹操派二人进攻未能取胜，生擒情节出自小说。

title: Mi Heng strips and drums before Cao Cao
summary: The brilliant, arrogant Mi Heng, made to serve as a drummer at a banquet, strips naked in front of the guests, drums the 'Yuyang' rhythm and abuses Cao Cao. Cao Cao sends him off to Liu Biao rather than kill him himself. The scene is in the Book of the Later Han.
summary_zh: 狂士祢衡被曹操罚作鼓吏，在宴会上当众裸身更衣，击《渔阳》鼓，痛骂曹操。曹操不愿背杀士之名，把他送给刘表。此事见于《后汉书·祢衡传》。

title: The physician Ji Ping tries to poison Cao Cao
summary: Joined to Dong Cheng's plot, the court physician Ji Ping puts poison in Cao Cao's medicine, is found out and tortured to death. Historically: a physician named Ji Ben did rebel at Xu, but in 218, eighteen years later and in a different plot. The novel moves him into the belt edict.
summary_zh: 太医吉平参与董承密谋，在曹操的药里下毒，事泄被拷打至死。史实：太医令吉本（吉平）确曾在许都起事，但那是218年与耿纪、韦晃同谋，晚了十八年，小说把他移进了衣带诏一案。

title: Cao Cao crushes Liu Bei, who flees to Yuan Shao
summary: With the plot exposed, Cao Cao executes Dong Cheng's household, including the pregnant Consort Dong, and marches east himself. Liu Bei's army breaks; he flees to Yuan Shao, and Guan Yu, holding Xiapi with Liu Bei's wives, is cut off.
summary_zh: 密谋败露，曹操诛杀董承全族，连有孕的董贵妃也不放过，随即亲征刘备。刘备兵败，逃往河北投奔袁绍；守下邳、保护刘备家眷的关羽陷入重围。

title: Guan Yu kills Yan Liang at Baima
summary: Yuan Shao's general Yan Liang besieges Baima. Guan Yu spots his parasol, charges through ten thousand men, stabs him and comes back with his head. One of the few great duels in the novel that the Records tells too, almost in the same words.
summary_zh: 袁绍大将颜良围白马。关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲入万军之中，刺颜良，斩其首而还。这是小说中少数几场《三国志》同样记载的阵前斩将，文字几乎一样。

title: Guan Yu's three conditions
summary: Surrounded on a hill, Guan Yu agrees to come over on three conditions: he surrenders to the Han, not to Cao Cao; Liu Bei's wives are protected; and he will leave the moment he learns where Liu Bei is. Historically: the Records says simply that Cao Cao captured Guan Yu and made him a general. The conditions are the novel's.
summary_zh: 关羽被困土山，提出三个条件才肯归顺：降汉不降曹；保护二位嫂嫂；一旦得知刘备下落，立即辞去。史实：《三国志·关羽传》只说“曹公禽羽以归，拜为偏将军”，约三事出自小说。

title: Guan Yu kills Wen Chou
summary: Yan Liang's sworn brother Wen Chou comes to avenge him and dies at Guan Yu's hand in three bouts. Historically: Wen Chou was killed at Yanjin when Cao Cao baited his cavalry with abandoned baggage; the Records credits Cao Cao's army, not Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 颜良的结义兄弟文丑前来报仇，与关羽交手不到三合即被斩杀。史实：《三国志·武帝纪》载曹操在延津抛弃辎重引诱袁军，趁其争抢时出击，斩了文丑，并未提到关羽。

title: Guan Yu hangs up his seal and leaves
summary: Having repaid Cao Cao with Yan Liang's head, Guan Yu seals up every gift, leaves a letter, and rides off to Liu Bei. Cao Cao forbids pursuit: each serves his own master. The Records tells it the same way.
summary_zh: 关羽斩颜良报答了曹操，将曹操所赐财物尽数封存，留书告辞，投奔刘备。曹操不许追赶，说“彼各为其主，勿追也”。《三国志·关羽传》记载相同。

title: Across five passes, six generals killed
summary: Escorting his sisters-in-law alone, Guan Yu forces his way through five passes and kills six of Cao Cao's commanders: Kong Xiu at Dongling Pass, Han Fu and Meng Tan at Luoyang, Bian Xi at Sishui, Wang Zhi at Xingyang and Qin Qi at the Yellow River ford. Historically: none of it happened, and none of the six generals is known to history. The route itself gives the game away: from Xu to the north it runs west to Luoyang and back east again, hundreds of li out of the way.
summary_zh: 关羽护送二嫂，千里走单骑，连闯五关，斩东岭关孔秀、洛阳韩福和孟坦、汜水关卞喜、荥阳王植、黄河渡口秦琪六将。史实：并无此事，六员守将也都不见于史书。路线本身就露了馅：从许都去河北，却先向西绕到洛阳再折回东边，平白多走了几百里。

title: Cai Yang killed, the brothers reunited at Gucheng
summary: Zhang Fei, holding the town of Gucheng, thinks Guan Yu has turned traitor; Guan Yu proves himself by beheading the pursuing Cai Yang before the third drumbeat ends, and the three brothers are together again. Historically: Cai Yang was killed by Liu Bei in Runan, not by Guan Yu.
summary_zh: 据守古城的张飞以为关羽降曹变节，关羽在三通鼓内斩了追来的曹将蔡阳以明心迹，兄弟三人在古城重聚。史实：《三国志·先主传》载蔡阳是在汝南被刘备所杀，与关羽无关。

title: Sun Ce kills Yu Ji and dies; Sun Quan succeeds
summary: Sun Ce executes the Taoist healer Yu Ji, whom his officers revere; the dead man's ghost haunts him until his wound reopens and he dies at twenty-six, leaving Jiangdong to his brother Sun Quan. Historically: Sun Ce died of wounds from an ambush by the retainers of Xu Gong, whom he had killed. Yu Ji's execution comes from the Jiangbiao zhuan and the Soushen ji, and Pei Songzhi already doubted it.
summary_zh: 孙策斩了深受将士敬奉的道士于吉，于吉阴魂作祟，孙策箭疮迸裂，年仅二十六岁而死，临终将江东交给弟弟孙权。史实：孙策是打猎时被他所杀的许贡的门客伏击，伤重而死。斩于吉之事出自《江表传》《搜神记》，裴松之已表示怀疑。

title: The battle of Guandu
summary: Yuan Shao comes south with a hundred thousand men; Cao Cao holds the line at Guandu with a fraction of that, for months, short of food. The Records and the novel agree on the battle that decided the north.
summary_zh: 袁绍率十万大军南下，曹操以寡兵据守官渡，相持数月，粮草将尽。这场决定北方归属的大战，史书和小说的记载基本一致。

title: Cao Cao burns the granary at Wuchao
summary: Yuan Shao's adviser Xu You, slighted, defects and tells Cao Cao where Yuan Shao's grain is stored. Cao Cao leads five thousand men there by night under Yuan banners and burns it all; Yuan Shao's army collapses.
summary_zh: 袁绍谋士许攸受了冷落，投奔曹操，献上袁军囤粮之地。曹操亲率五千步骑打着袁军旗号夜袭乌巢，尽焚其粮，袁军随之崩溃。

title: Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao again at Cangting
summary: Yuan Shao gathers what is left and fights again at Cangting on the Yellow River, and is beaten again.
summary_zh: 袁绍收拾残部，在黄河边的仓亭再战，又被曹操击败。

title: Liu Bei shelters with Liu Biao
summary: Beaten in Runan, Liu Bei goes south to his kinsman Liu Biao, governor of Jingzhou, who posts him at Xinye to guard the northern border. He will stay seven years.
summary_zh: 刘备在汝南被曹操击败，南投同宗荆州牧刘表，刘表让他屯驻新野，防备北方。他在荆州一待就是七年。

title: Cao Cao floods Ye and takes Ji province
summary: Yuan Shao dies in 202 and his sons Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang fight each other. Cao Cao digs a channel from the Zhang River round Ye and floods it; after months the city starves and falls, and Ye becomes his capital.
summary_zh: 202年袁绍病死，袁谭、袁尚兄弟相争。曹操围邺，掘堑引漳河水灌城，城中饿死大半，城破后邺成为曹操的大本营。

title: Cao Pi takes Lady Zhen
summary: In the sack of Ye, Cao Pi finds Yuan Xi's wife Lady Zhen hiding in the palace and takes her for himself. She will be the mother of the second Wei emperor.
summary_zh: 邺城破时，曹丕在袁府中见到袁熙之妻甄氏，纳为己妻。她后来生下魏明帝曹叡。

title: White Wolf Mountain and Guo Jia's last plan
summary: Cao Cao crosses the desolate country beyond the Wall, defeats the Wuhuan at White Wolf Mountain and kills their chief Tadun. Guo Jia dies on the way back, having predicted that Gongsun Kang would send the heads of the fleeing Yuan brothers if left alone. He does.
summary_zh: 曹操远征塞外，在白狼山大破乌桓，斩其首领蹋顿。郭嘉在归途中病逝，他生前料定只要不逼，公孙康自会斩送逃去辽东的袁尚、袁熙。果然如此。

title: The horse that leapt the Tan Stream
summary: Warned that Liu Biao's in-laws mean to kill him at a banquet, Liu Bei rides out and comes up against the Tan Stream. His horse Dilu, said to bring bad luck to its master, leaps three zhang across and saves him. Historically: the leap is told in the Shiyu cited in the notes, and the commentator Sun Sheng called it a fabrication.
summary_zh: 刘备得知蔡瑁要在宴上害他，骑马逃出，被檀溪拦住去路。人说妨主的的卢马一跃三丈，跳过檀溪救了他。史实：此事出自裴注所引《世语》，孙盛已指其为虚妄之言。

title: The Water Mirror names the Sleeping Dragon
summary: The recluse Sima Hui, the 'Water Mirror', tells Liu Bei that ordinary scholars cannot see the times, and that the men who can are the Sleeping Dragon and the Young Phoenix. Historically: the Xiangyang ji cited in the notes records the remark.
summary_zh: 隐士司马徽（号水镜先生）对刘备说，儒生俗士不识时务，识时务者在乎俊杰，此间自有伏龙、凤雏。史实：裴注引《襄阳记》记有此语。

title: Shan Fu breaks Cao Ren's formation
summary: Under the false name Shan Fu, Xu Shu becomes Liu Bei's strategist and defeats Cao Ren by breaking his 'Eight Gates Golden Lock' formation. Historically: Xu Shu did serve Liu Bei at Xinye, but no such battle is recorded.
summary_zh: 徐庶化名单福，做了刘备的军师，识破并攻破曹仁的“八门金锁阵”。史实：徐庶确在新野投奔刘备，但并无此战记载。

title: Xu Shu recommends Zhuge Liang as he leaves
summary: Cao Cao lures Xu Shu away with a forged letter from his mother. As he rides off he turns back to tell Liu Bei of Zhuge Liang. Historically: Xu Shu did recommend Zhuge Liang, but while still in Liu Bei's service; he left only in 208, when his mother was captured during the flight from Changban.
summary_zh: 曹操以伪造的母亲书信骗走徐庶，徐庶临行回马，向刘备举荐诸葛亮。史实：《三国志·诸葛亮传》载徐庶荐诸葛亮时仍在刘备帐下；他离开刘备是在208年长坂兵败、母亲被曹军所获之后。

title: Three visits to the thatched cottage
summary: Liu Bei goes three times to Zhuge Liang's cottage in the hills, the third time in snow, and waits on the steps while he sleeps. Historically: the visits are real; Zhuge Liang himself wrote in his memorial that Liu Bei 'visited me three times in my thatched cottage'. The snow and the waiting are the novel's.
summary_zh: 刘备三顾诸葛亮的茅庐，第三次冒雪而去，站在阶下等候他午睡醒来。史实：三顾确有其事，诸葛亮在《出师表》中亲笔写道“三顾臣于草庐之中”；风雪与立候是小说的渲染。

title: The Longzhong plan: the realm in three
summary: Zhuge Liang lays out the plan: the north is Cao Cao's and cannot be fought yet, the east is Sun Quan's and must be an ally; take Jingzhou and Yizhou, and wait for the moment to march on the centre. The speech is in the Records, and the next fifteen years follow it.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮分析天下：北方曹操不可与争锋，江东孙权可以为援而不可图，应先取荆州、益州，待天下有变，再两路北伐。这番话载于《三国志·诸葛亮传》，此后十五年的局势大体照此展开。

title: Sun Quan avenges his father on Huang Zu
summary: Sun Quan finally takes Xiakou and kills Huang Zu, whose men killed his father Sun Jian seventeen years before.
summary_zh: 孙权攻破夏口，斩黄祖，报了十七年前父亲孙坚被黄祖部下射杀之仇。
